note: column-split QKV input (15 dies per layer, 2400 CIM dies 49x49): the unit receives one 1-byte output row per layer instead of ten 2-byte partial-sum rows; mesh 0.4 GB/s, 8 macros; K/V cache at 2 bytes per element (aligned with the GPU baselines' 16-bit cache)

sources.digital_unit: DR-9 reference (2 TMAC/s, 25.6 GB/s K/V LPDDR4 two 32-bit channels, 2 GB, 12.5 GB/s hub = one Simba GRS macro, 8 MB buffer)
sources.mesh_0.4: HERMES-class analog link rate (3.2 Gbit/s per link) -- the reference tier
sources.mesh_12.5: Simba GRS package link, 25 Gb/s/pin x 4 lanes = 12.5 GB/s per direction (Zimmer et al., JSSC 2020) -- the upper evaluated tier
sources.kv_51.2: design assumption: two 32-bit LPDDR5-6400 channels = 51.2 GB/s raw (JEDEC LPDDR5 data rate), same channel organisation as the reference LPDDR4 point
sources.die_16_macros: capacity variant of the same die (2x macros), existing measured account

precision: CIM: 8-bit weights and activations (accounts), 2-byte partial sums, 16-bit digital intermediates, K/V 1 byte per element; GPU: see gpu_baselines.csv
fixed_mapping: the prefill S=512 confirmation representative layout of the record, used for both phases (decode evaluated under the same seats)
